component.name: Moku
component.summary: Reader and player for manga, light novels, and anime

description.p: Moku is a cross-platform desktop app for manga, light novels, and anime. It bundles the Tsunagu backend and its sandboxed extension engine, so browsing sources, reading, watching, downloads, and tracker sync work out of the box with nothing else to install.
Features include library management, reading and watch history, chapter and episode tracking, AniList and MyAnimeList sync, AniSkip for anime, a built-in reader and player, and Discord Rich Presence.
